name: @sterio/api-lambda
description: Jamshot API running on AWS Lambda using @codegenie/serverless-express

scripts.build: rm -rf dist && mkdir -p dist && npx esbuild index.js --bundle --platform=node --target=node22 --format=esm --outfile=dist/index.mjs --external:@aws-sdk/* --external:pg --external:sharp --external:music-metadata --external:bcryptjs --external:express --external:hono --external:@hono/node-server --external:@codegenie/serverless-express --external:nodemailer --external:multer --external:cors --external:express-rate-limit --external:express-slow-down --external:jsonwebtoken --external:cookie-parser --external:axios --external:better-auth --external:stripe && jq '{ name, version, type, dependencies }' package.json > dist/package.json && cd dist && npm install --production --omit=dev
